stem.text: Lactide is an intermediate in the manufacture of a synthetic fibre.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of lactide: a six-membered ring containing two ester oxygens and two C=O groups, with a methyl group on each of the two carbons next to the ring oxygens. Printed label: lactide.
